cases.title: Opening a blank Notepad editor
steps: Create a new blank Notepad tab without changing existing tabs.
Verify the Text editor control is visible.
cases.notes: Notepad has been opened and a fresh tab is ready

cases.title: Entering and reading editor text
steps: Enter a known string in the Text editor.
Read the editor text.
cases.expected: the editor text equals the entered string

cases.title: Undoing and redoing an editor change
steps: Enter a known string in the Text editor.
Undo the edit.
Redo the edit.
Save the document under pytest's temporary directory.

cases.title: Keeping text independent across tabs
steps: Enter and save text in the first tab.
Add a new tab.
Enter and save different text in the new tab.
Select each tab in turn.
cases.expected: each tab retains its own saved text

cases.title: Saving a document to a temporary file
steps: Enter a known string in the Text editor.
Save the document to a path under pytest's temporary directory.
cases.expected: the saved file contains exactly the entered string

cases.title: Opening a temporary text file
steps: Create a text file under pytest's temporary directory.
Open the file in Notepad.
cases.expected: the editor displays the file contents

cases.title: Opening the SQLdm main window
steps: Verify SQLdm is installed on the system
Launch the installed SQLdm client executable
Wait for the main window to appear
cases.expected: Main window is visible with correct title
cases.notes: SQLdm basic smoke test - verifies successful application launch

cases.title: SQLdm main window is enabled and responsive
steps: Launch the installed SQLdm client executable
Wait for the main window to appear
Verify the window is enabled and not in a disabled state
cases.expected: Main window is visible, enabled, and responsive to user input
cases.notes: Verifies SQLdm application responsiveness after launch

cases.title: SQLdm displays status information
steps: Launch the installed SQLdm client executable
Wait for the main window to appear
Check the status bar for status or connection information
cases.expected: Status bar is visible and contains connection/status information
cases.notes: Verifies SQLdm status bar is accessible and displayable
